Subject: Dedicated GPU pool — initial MOP and timeline

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our initial MOP (Operational Plan) with the sizing we discussed. High level asks: a US-based dedicated pool, initial guaranteed capacity for 40 concurrent inference streams, and an ability to burst up to 120 (for marketing spikes). We need clear autoscale/burst guardrails and a regional fallback plan in case of capacity constraints.

Can your team confirm the following:
- Typical ramp time for a new pool to reach steady state (hours/days)
- Recommended autoscale thresholds and burst ceilings for our workload (low latency, 4k context)
- Any networking prerequisites (peering, CIDR, firewall rules) we should prepare before the activation window

We'd like to schedule a 30-minute handoff with your CS + Ops tomorrow afternoon (PDT) if possible. Procurement is copied for timing and SOW follow-up.

Attachments: cobaltworks_mop_v1.pdf

Best,

Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool — initial MOP and timeline

Thanks Elena — got the MOP and appreciate the details. Quick confirmations and next steps below.

Short answers up front:
- Pool ramp: 4–8 hours to provision the initial pool + config; 12–24 hours to reach steady-state under production traffic (depends on model load and warm cache).
- Autoscale suggestions: target concurrency 40 (guaranteed), scale-to-burst 120 with a conservative burst window of 15 minutes and a cooldown of 10 minutes. We recommend a hard burst cap at 150 requests to prevent runaway spend.
- Networking: we need your VPC CIDR, public egress ranges for our peering (we provide a small set of IPs), and KMS key ARN if you require CMK encryption for model weights/cache.

Proposed schedule: 30-minute handoff tomorrow (Mon 26 Apr) at 2:00 PM PDT. Monica (CS lead) and Soojin (inference infra) will join to cover implementation checklist and technical prerequisites. Please confirm or propose an alternate time.

Pre-req checklist (please share before the call if you can):
- Signed SOW or at least PO number (procurement is cc'd)
- VPC CIDR and NetOps contact
- KMS key details (if using customer-managed keys)
- Initial model artifacts or spec (size, context length, batch characteristics)

I'll also drop our activation playbook link after the call.

Attachments referenced: cobaltworks_mop_v1.pdf (we reviewed).

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool — initial MOP and timeline

Elena / Logan — thanks. A few operational notes I want on the record ahead of the handoff so Ops can prepare the runbook quickly: 

1) Autoscale & burst policy (recommendation)
   - Guaranteed capacity: 40 concurrent inference streams (minimum target).
   - Auto-scale floor: 40. Scale-up policy: add 10 nodes per 2% sustained queue for 90s.
   - Burst window: allow immediate scale to 3x (120) for a 15-minute window; enforce cooldown of 10 minutes post-burst.
   - Hard cap: 150 concurrent to protect shared pool and multilayer fallbacks.

2) Cache & warmup strategy
   - Pre-warm KV cache for top-100 prefixes during planned marketing events (we can pre-warm during off-peak).
   - Recommend application-side retry/backoff (503 -> linear backoff with jitter) and client-visible throttle signals.

3) Regional fallback plan
   - Primary: us-west-2; fallback: us-east-1. If both constrained, automated region-level downgrade to a smaller model variant (quantized) with a notification to your SREs.

4) Security/compliance asks (just reminders)
   - Provide KMS ARN if you need customer-managed keys (required for model asset encryption).
   - Confirm audit window needs for request logs (30 / 90 / 365 days).

Operational timeline we plan after SOW (subject to your NetOps readiness):
   Day 0: Network peering & firewall rules validated
   Day 1: Pool provision + baseline config (4–8 hours)
   Day 2: Load ramp, cache warm, smoke tests (12–24 hours)
   Day 3: Go-live window and on-call coverage for 48 hours

I'll prepare a short activation runbook and share it immediately after our call. Logan — please confirm the 2pm PT slot if still good.

— Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

1) NetOps contact + peering details (IP allowlist we'll use: 34.82.12.0/28, 34.82.12.16/28 — we'll confirm in ticket)
2) Your preferred activation window (we have an available maintenance window Tue 04 May 00:00–04:00 UTC or Wed 05 May 02:00–06:00 UTC)
